name: Sasakura Riko
source:
Inclination: Sucking on things
Interest: Patchwork
Likes: Right angles, Squares, Things in order
Dislikes: Things out of order, Insects

A 2nd year student on the discipline committee who works day and night to uphold the school's public morals.
A dependable person who is excellent at helping others out. She can't leave a person in trouble alone but because of that she also seems to be a trouble magnet.

Unusual Ability: Wind Flag
She is able to protect others from being hypnotized , however her ability doesn't work on herself.
